label: Ordered-love reading: GOD_4 wills a distinct non-rational effect's esse as ordered to others
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, sibling reading of the causal-willing step, attribution deferred (ST I q.20 a.2 ad 3: irrational creatures are loved as it were with love of desire, as ordered to rational creatures and to God). For every GOD_4 g with will and every distinct, non-rational x in act in esse whose esse g causes: g wills x's being in esse as ordered to some y that is rational or is g, and does not will that good to x as recipient. On such an effect it contradicts the recipient-directed reading used by the registered love route; it says nothing about rational creatures. It is the source-internal version of the non-recipient-directed production the foreseen-collateral rival needs, restricted to non-rational effects. OPEN; not used by any registered argument.
